Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client

Interface PbcsPlanTypeSubstitutionVariable

All Superinterfaces:
PbcsApplicationSubstitutionVariable, PbcsObject, PbcsSubstitutionVariable
All Known Implementing Classes:
PbcsPlanTypeSubstitutionVariableImpl
public interface PbcsPlanTypeSubstitutionVariable extends PbcsApplicationSubstitutionVariable
A substitution variable defined for a single plan type, whose scope is PbcsSubstitutionVariableScope.PLAN_TYPE. Its parent is the plan type, and it belongs to that plan type's application.
Since:
3.1.0

  • Method Details

    • getPlanTypeName

      String getPlanTypeName()
      Gets the name of the plan type the variable is defined for. Unlike getPlanType(), this never needs a call to the server.
      Returns:
      the plan type name, such as Plan1

    • getPlanType

      PbcsPlanType getPlanType()
      Gets the plan type the variable is defined for. For a variable read through PbcsApplication.getVariables(), the plan type is looked up on first use, the same way as PbcsApplication.getPlanType(String), which checks with the server that it exists.
      Returns:
      the plan type
